description: This file defines a layout component for a Qwik-based frontend application. It imports styling and Qwik-specific functions, sets up HTTP caching via a request handler, and returns a JSX component that includes a slot for nested content.

methods.name: onGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by setting cache control headers.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Creates a Qwik component that renders a main element with a slot.

methods.name: useStyles$
methods.description: Applies styles imported from the CSS file to the component.
